MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Slipstream feels like a natural next choice because Bonnie Raitt's blues guitar and soulful vocals fit the blues and roots-rock listening reflected in my recent choices.",
    "Coda, Weird Scenes Inside the Gold Mine, and Ride Out connect with my interest in classic and blues-influenced rock, while Boys & Girls appeals through its blues and soul sound."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Babel and The Lumineers lean toward acoustic folk-pop, which does not give me the guitar-led blues and roots-rock sound I want right now.",
    "Blurred Lines feels too dance-oriented for my current mood, and It's the Girls! offers a girl-group covers focus that does not connect with what I am seeking.",
    "Dylan's archival collection, Coda's outtakes, and the Doors compilation interest me, but that interest is weaker than my desire to hear Slipstream today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat folk-pop and roots rock as equally appealing to me, although their sound and energy matter more than their broad connection.",
    "An artist's connection to classic rock seems to count too heavily when the particular release is an archive, outtakes collection, or compilation I would save for later."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The combination of expressive blues guitar and soulful singing matters especially strongly to me right now, which is why Slipstream stands out.",
    "I rarely choose something unless it feels closely relevant; finding an artist interesting does not mean I want that particular album today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my blues and classic-rock interests but stretch them too far into folk-pop and releases I would only consider later."
}
